subject: Regional service failover and customer steps - US/EU/APAC traffic healthcheck
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2029-10-05T15:12:00Z
Subject: Initial incident coordination - regional service degradation (US/EU/APAC)

Team,

We're seeing degraded metrics from two cloud regions and elevated error rates for the hosted inference endpoints across US-West, eu-west and ap-southeast. Pager flagged a regional connectivity issue at 15:04Z. Initial infra signals point to a third-party cloud networking flap affecting some egress routes.

Immediate asks:
- Rishi: can you confirm the plan for routing traffic to our healthy capacity and whether we should flip DNS weights or rely on the edge weight steering?
- Lauren: I will prepare a short customer advisory; please review wording for SLA/credit language.
- I will compile impacted customer list; prioritize any with active contract SLAs.

Attachments: I attached a preliminary impact matrix.

I will follow up with a customer-facing note within 45 minutes.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: customer-impact-matrix.csv
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2029-10-05T15:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial incident coordination - regional service degradation (US/EU/APAC)

Grace,

Summary of quick mitigation options after looking at the control plane and edge telemetry:
- Cause: intermittent BGP flap at provider edge for two zones; traffic to our gateway IPs is being dropped intermittently from specific POPs.
- Short-term mitigations:
  * Increase weight on fallback regions via our traffic controller (already queued). This is low-risk and should cut the error volume by rerouting new connections.
  * Enable client SDK failover knob (SDK v2.3) which will prefer our dedicated endpoints in healthy regions for new sessions. We can ship a short TTL flag via runtime config.
  * Push a rolling update to edge proxies to prefer cached KV responses for warm tokens to reduce cold-start droputs.
- Operational checks: run the attached pcap capture and verify connection resets. I started a capture and attached the top-level trace.

I will execute the weight change now and monitor for 10 minutes. If errors drop by >=60% we keep the change and inform customers. If not, we will escalate with the cloud provider.

Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: ops@acme-corp.com, support@nebula.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2029-10-05T16:05:00Z
Subject: Action required: regional traffic steering and short-term workarounds

Hi Javier and Priya,

Quick update and recommended actions while we work through a regional network flap that is impacting some connections in US-West, eu-west and APAC-Southeast. We want to minimize your error volume and keep latency predictable.

1) What we changed for you (already applied):
- We increased traffic weight away from affected POPs and prioritized our healthy clusters in other regions. This should route new sessions to healthy capacity.

2) Recommended customer steps (please run these now):
- If you have DNS-based region weighting, increase TTL to 30s and set fallback weights to prefer the US-East or eu-central endpoints.
- If you use the Redwood SDK: enable the runtime flag redwood.enable_region_failover=true (SDK versions 2.3+). This instructs the SDK to open connections preferentially to healthy endpoints for new requests.
- For critical batch jobs: pause and retry with exponential backoff after 60s to avoid client side storming.

3) Verification checklist:
- After enabling the SDK flag, please run a simple healthcheck: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.com/v1/health
- Share the response time and error rate for a 5 minute window. We will correlate with our edge logs.

We are monitoring and will provide a post-incident summary and remediation plan. I will also share a draft postmortem in the next 8 hours for your review and any impact-related questions.

If you're on a tight SLA, reply to this thread and we'll open a dedicated support bridge.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the quick guidance. We applied the SDK flag and adjusted DNS weights as suggested. Initial check: health endpoint returned 200 with 98ms median latency and ~1.2% 500 errors in the last 5 minutes. We'll keep the bridge open if you need more traces.

Two asks from us:
- Can you confirm whether token rotation or any session affinity changes are needed for our internal gateway?
- Once you have the postmortem draft, can you call out customer-facing SLAs and credit eligibility? We need the precise time window for outage and affected regions for our records.

Appreciate the rapid response.

Javier
Head of Platform Ops
Acme Corp
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: ops@acme-corp.com, support@nebula.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2029-10-05T18:10:00Z
Subject: Postmortem draft and next steps - request for customer feedback

Javier, Priya,

Thanks for the confirmation and for running the checks. Attached is our postmortem draft outlining timeline, root cause hypothesis, mitigation steps, and immediate configuration recommendations for customers. Key points:
- Incident window (observed errors above baseline): 2029-10-05T14:58:00Z - 2029-10-05T17:22:00Z
- Primary impact: increased 5xxs and connection resets for a subset of egress POPs in US-West and eu-west; APAC showed intermittent packet loss from a provider layer.
- Customer guidance included: enable SDK region failover, prefer dedicated endpoints, short TTL DNS weights, and batch job backoff.

Requested actions from you:
- Please review the draft and flag any factual errors, especially the outage window and the list of services you observed failing.
- Confirm whether you require a signed SLA credit application; we will provide the necessary evidence by next business day.

We plan to publish a public summary after customer review and a legal review on 2029-10-07. If you need earlier confirmation for accounting or compliance records, reply with a rquest and we'll fast-track.

Best,
Grace
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
